exceptions.reason: Specimens paint their background inside a shadow root, which axe can't see, so it measures their text against the page behind them (dark-scheme text came out at 1.16:1 on #f4f4f4).
main and the side nav scroll inside the window, so axe can't sample the background behind text scrolled out of view.
lit-icon sizes its glyph with font-size; it holds no text.
lit-badge's 10.5px and Web Awesome's l/xl sizes (20px, 25px) sit off the theme's type scale; vpl-ok1h decides the scale.
ARIA state sits on the host rather than the inner control; vpl-a0rr moves it.
